exposure: mode of delivery (vaginal breech delivery, planned Cesarean section, emergency Cesarean section)
cohort: 176 women with singleton fetus in breech presentation who delivered between 2015 and 2019.
finding: Vaginal delivery was found to be a very safe option for both mothers and newborns in cases of breech presentation.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was identified as a safe option for mother and newborn, with no significant difference in birth weight between delivery groups, but emergency C-section had the highest rate of birth injuries (10%).
